pool.text: Ming dynasty protects the harbor with the fortress giving Xiamen its name.
Portuguese explorers reach Xiamen for the very first time in history.
Koxinga drives the Dutch from Taiwan and relocates his operations there.
East India Company trades extensively and constructs a factory in Xiamen.
Xiamen is captured between Guangzhou and Zhoushan during military conflicts.
The island's original name of Siming is restored after the Xinhai Revolution.
The name Xiamen is restored and planned as a city.
Japan occupies Xiamen Island during the course of World War II.
Communists capture Xiamen and Gulangyu during the Chinese Civil War.
Xiamen is designated as one of the first special economic zones.
Xiamen Museum is founded and initially located on Gulangyu Island.
Xiamen Bridge opens as the first road bridge crossing the straits.
Governments initiate Three Mini-Links to restore ferry and mail connections.
The chest-clapping dance is included in the first National Intangible Cultural Heritage List.
Protests occur against the building of a paraxylene chemical factory.
Xiamen BRT is put into operation on the last day of August.
Xiamen Port incorporates neighboring port of Zhangzhou to form a major port.
Xiamen subway initiates construction on the first day of April.
Gulangyu Island is officially listed as a world cultural heritage site.
Xiamen begins offering 144-hour visa-free transit services to foreign travelers.
